threshold.description: Minimum match score threshold for -t. Only matches scoring above this value are displayed.

known_hash_files.description: List of files containing known signatures to match against (-m flag). Each entry is a file path.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode (-v) to print filename to stderr as it is being hashed.

recursive.description: Enable recursive mode (-r) to traverse all subdirectories.

silent.description: Enable silent mode (-s) to suppress all error messages.

bare.description: Enable bare mode (-b) to strip leading directory information from displayed filenames.

relative_paths.description: Enable relative paths (-l) to display relative file paths instead of absolute.

csv_output.description: Enable comma-separated output (-c) for matching modes. Displays input file, known file, and matching score.

all_matches.description: Display all matches regardless of score (-a).

input_files.description: List of input files or directories to process.
